source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The May 2024 SummaryFrameManager documentation adds a concrete iframe parameter type and a typed callback signature that states its boolean argument. For exported module APIs, document argument shape and callback meaning when the type is not clear from the name. SessionStoreManager received similar typed return and nullable annotations in the next cleanup.
title: State parameter types in exported module JSDoc
